## Status as of 2026-09-19

**Status as of 2026-09-19**
- Catalog and hashes now live in private LMFMC (`data/authority/catalog/`), not `data/source_catalog.csv`; update paths when a license lands.
- All 13 datasets are already parsed into the private 261,666-shot corpus (PR #23) - outreach changes redistribution status only.
- Absorbed: #2 (Blackmore 10,169-shot TrackMan corpus, sha fae80d32...) and #16 (Kaggle jamieb122 R50 verification).
- Also add the 4 NOASSERTION studies from #14 (Bliss 2021, Wells 2025, MacKenzie 2020, Sweeney 2009) to the outreach list.
- No owner contacted yet; needs a human to send the requests.

---

## Context

Thirteen hash-pinned GitHub shot-level datasets in the catalog have **no stated license**, so roughly 5,000 real shots (TrackMan, Mevo/Mevo+, Garmin R10/R50, SkyTrak, Rapsodo MLM2PRO, Square Golf, Awesome Golf) remain reference-only: `dmombo_mevo_plus_db`, `jacqzang_trackman_practice`, `jgamblin_garmin_r10_sessions`, `hoffpauir_skytrak_sessions`, `sghill_mevo_range`, `callejo_trackman_sessions`, `j72jones_trackman_7iron`, `mmender2_mlm2pro_clubs`, `ummerr_garmin_r50_ledger`, `tomcox_garmin_range`, `mpgentleman_awesome_golf_sample`, `bluedaniel_square_gapping`, plus the original `blackmore_trackman_10169`.

## Work

- [ ] Prioritize by value: Blackmore (10,169 TrackMan shots), dmombo (2,264 Mevo+ shots), jacqzang (1,184 TrackMan shots), jgamblin (16 R10 sessions with weather columns) first.
- [ ] Open a polite issue on each repository (or use the contact in its README) asking the owner to add a license (suggest CC BY 4.0 or CC0 for the data files) and to confirm the data is their own and free of other players' personal information; link this project's CONTRIBUTING policy.
- [ ] Track responses per source; when a license lands, update the catalog (`license_spdx`, `pinned_ref`/`sha256` refresh) and queue the dataset for shot-level ingestion.
- [ ] Note datasets with named third parties (dmombo, callejo) will also need player-consent confirmation per CONTRIBUTING before redistribution regardless of license.

## Acceptance

Every listed owner has been contacted with a tracked outcome (licensed, declined, or no response after a stated waiting period), and the catalog reflects any license changes.

## Folded in from backlog triage 2026-09-19

- [ ] Verify `kaggle_jamieb122_r50` (kaggle.com/datasets/jamieb122/golf-swing-and-trajectory-data): record Kaggle license, row count, schema, SHA-256 pin in the LMFMC catalog; flag for corpus ingestion if redistributable (from #16)

title: Request redistribution licenses from GitHub shot-dataset owners
